description: Use Cursor Agent as a model-neutral, read-only consultation harness. The provider and exact Cursor catalog model ID are separate required fields. Runs `agent --print --mode ask` without --force/--trust, never changes spend settings, and never falls back to another model or provider.

includeDirs.description: Relative additional workspace directories passed to Cursor Agent with repeatable --add-dir.

model.description: Exact Cursor catalog model ID from `agent --list-models`; Ask LLM does not rewrite it, echoes it back as `model`, and refuses Auto or other noncanonical IDs. The CLI's display label is returned separately as `reportedModel`.

prompt.description: Question, review, or analysis task for Cursor Agent ask mode.

provider.description: Canonical provider family of the selected Cursor model (claude, codex, gemini, grok); kept separate from the cursor-agent harness and verified against the requested and CLI-reported model ID.

sessionId.description: Prior Cursor conversation ID to resume. Omit on the first call and reuse the returned sessionId.

name: ask-cursor-agent
